rules.content:
/*
Nitrogen ransomware (distributed via malvertising)
*/

rule Nitrogen_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.nitrogen"
        description = "Detects Nitrogen ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "Nitrogen" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "NITROGEN" ascii
        $s3 = "nitrogen.onion" ascii nocase
        $s4 = "!!README_WARNING!!" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
